criteria.requirement: Forced nonterminal and color_system=None yield plain ready newline. A forced terminal with no_color=True removes color but can retain bold ANSI styling, so it does not guarantee no ANSI sequences. Explicit plain output must disable the color/style emission path rather than treating no_color as a universal plain-text switch.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
